title: Load the dishwasher
materials: plates and cups from the sink

steps.text: Scrape food into the trash or compost.
steps.tip: No big chunks in the dishwasher.

steps.text: Rinse if your house does that.
steps.tip: Ask once; then remember the house rule.

steps.text: Plates in the bottom rack, facing the center.
steps.tip: Cups and glasses go on the top rack, upside down.

steps.text: Utensils in the basket, handles down if that is the house rule.
steps.tip: Do not put knives in if a grown-up said no.

done_when: Sink of dirty dishes is empty (except pots a grown-up keeps out)
Racks are not jammed so the arm can spin
parent_notes: grown_up_required for knives, breakables, and starting the machine. Kid loads; grown-up runs it.
